title: Sell Mineral Rights in Clarksville, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Clarksville, PA | Greene County
metaDescription: Clarksville sits in Greene County's deep Marcellus and Utica core. We buy mineral and royalty interests directly from PA owners, cash offers with no broker fee.
heroLead: Greene County is about as deep in the Marcellus core as Pennsylvania gets, and Clarksville families holding minerals here often sit on genuinely active ground.
intro: Clarksville is a small Greene County borough, but Greene County itself has been one of the most heavily drilled counties in the entire play, with both Marcellus and, in places, Utica formations under active development. That's a very different starting point than a lot of the flank counties around it. If you own minerals near Clarksville, there's a real chance an operator has already permitted or drilled nearby, which changes how we think about value.
We buy Greene County interests directly, and we'll tell you honestly if recent activity near your tract supports a stronger offer or if it's still early days for your section.

sections.heading: Deep Core, Both Formations
paragraphs: Unlike counties where Marcellus is the only game, parts of Greene County have seen interest in the deeper Utica-Point Pleasant interval as well, largely from operators like CNX and EQT who hold significant acreage positions in this part of the state. That stacked-pay potential is one reason Greene County land has drawn sustained attention over the years, even as drilling elsewhere in the state has slowed.

That said, stacked-pay potential doesn't mean every acre near Clarksville is under an active unit right now. We check current permitting and production data specific to your section before quoting anything.

sections.heading: Waynesburg Courthouse and Your Chain of Title
paragraphs: Greene County deeds and leases are recorded at the courthouse in Waynesburg, and because this county has been a drilling hotspot for so long, title work here can get complicated fast, competing leases, old severances, unresolved probate. We do that chain-of-title work ourselves before making an offer, so you're not stuck untangling decades of paperwork on your own.
If your family's interest has never been formally probated through a prior generation, that's a common snag we can usually work through.

sections.heading: Reading Your Royalty Statement Honestly
paragraphs: With this much drilling history in Greene County, we see a wide range of royalty statements, some clean, some with post-production deductions that eat a real chunk of the gross value. Pennsylvania's Guaranteed Minimum Royalty Act sets a floor on the royalty rate, not on what gets deducted afterward, so a shrinking check doesn't automatically mean something's wrong. We'll look at your actual statement and tell you what we see.

faqs.question: Is Clarksville in an actively drilled part of Greene County?
faqs.answer: Greene County overall is one of the most active counties in the Marcellus and Utica plays, but activity still varies by specific section, so we check what's happened near your tract before quoting.

faqs.question: Could my interest cover both Marcellus and Utica gas?
faqs.answer: Possibly, depending on how your deed is worded and what depths were conveyed. We review the language carefully rather than assuming.

faqs.question: What if there's a title problem, like an unresolved estate, on my interest?
faqs.answer: Common in a county with this much drilling history. We regularly work through unresolved probate and competing claims as part of buying an interest.
